Soma khulira lia Nyasaye wuwo Omulesi owaloonga.
Soma! Ne Nyasaye wuwo Omulesi ni Omuhani Okhushila boosi.
Yechesia Omundu kalia akayalali namanyile tawe.
Shikali kario tawe! Toto Omundu abetsanga omufuru.
Toto khu Nyasaye wuwo Omulesi niho wamakalushilo.
Omulutsi kakhabanga ayingana mana akalukhe inyuma?
Shamanyilekho ta mbu toto Nyasaye alolanga?
Tawe! Nalalekha tawe, khulamukhwesulula khwiswi lia imberi woomurue.
Liswi lia imberi woomurue libeyi, lietsimbi!
Tawe! Olamuwulila tawe! Ra obweni hasi (nosujudila Nyasaye), ne mwisitiekhwo!
